name: pigment64
notes: Built with cargo build --release --locked from the 0.6.3 git tag (rustc 1.98.1, aarch64-apple-darwin) in a scratchpad build dir; bin/pigment64 is that build. Upstream MIT licence. test.sh makes a 4x2 RGBA PNG with pure Python, converts it to N64 RGBA16 and checks the exact bytes, converts back to PNG and to bin again (round trip), and checks an I8 output size. Folder also holds .crates.toml and .crates2.json from an earlier cargo install from crates.io 0.6.3; these are leftover cargo metadata and do not affect the binary.
